appDescription: A driving diary app that records each drive from vehicle signals, writes a diary after parking, and plays notes left at specific places on the route.

function.name: TAKE_IT_SLOW
function.description: Called when the driver says they want to take it slow (e.g. '차곡차곡, 천천히 갈래'). Remembers the current spot so the driver can review it after parking, and asks the navigation for a more comfortable route. It does not change the car's speed.

function.name: SAVE_NOTE_HERE
function.description: Saves a short spoken note at the car's current position so it is played at the same spot on the next drive to this destination.

note.description: The note to save, in the driver's own words.

function.name: READ_LATEST_DIARY
function.description: Returns the title and text of the driving diary written after the driver's most recent drive.
